status: Declarative inert generation recipes for worker-owned NON-INTERACTION units; not executed or generated by triage
common: Wrap generated payload in --- LF / --- LF and append # BODY LF. On any parse/presentation limit failure, retain exact candidate in non-executing literal fallback, preserve BODY as a real heading, and return no partial table.

recipes.oracle: One sequence node plus N scalars; presentation stays under independent caps for these short values.

STREAM_START, DOCUMENT_START, SCALAR, DOCUMENT_END, STREAM_END. Default event cap is defense in depth and may be dominated by node/depth caps; do not invent an unreachable default-boundary test. Internal injected limits only, no app flag.

recipes.payloadRecipe: First line a0: &a0 [x, x] LF. For integers i = 1 through 16, append ai: &ai [*a(i-1), *a(i-1)] LF, substituting decimal i and i-1 into names; no spaces inside alias names. Last line result: *a16 LF.
recipes.oracle: Input/depth/owned node count are small; display traversal stops at a shared visit/output cap, never expands an unbounded object graph. Do not require which shared display cap wins.

recipes.payloadRecipe: Line a: &a followed by 20000 ASCII x characters LF. Lines b0: *a LF through b63: *a LF in numeric order.
recipes.oracle: Decoded values alone exceed 1 MiB after reuse; aliases stay edges during parsing. Do not truncate the literal recovery candidate.

recipes.internalLimitRecipe: Use an independently specified expected flat projection for this simple map (the public projection contract must be documented by worker). Count all emitted UTF-8 label/value bytes and visits explicitly. Inject each limit at exact required count minus one, equal count, and plus one with other caps high.
recipes.oracle: Worker supplies exact numeric oracles for chosen row-label spelling, not a self-comparison to parser output. Triage cannot claim a production row API already exists.
Iterative current-path cycle detection, not repeated depth recursion.
Linear envelope scan still finds closing line and original physical body lines after parse cap is exceeded; metadata never enters cmark.

recipes.recipe: Worker units render independent fixture strings concurrently, compare each to independent expected semantic data and a serial control, then release snapshots on detached and ordinary paths. No windows, files opened by app, or event loops.
recipes.oracle: No shared parser buffers/alias tables/HTML context; scalar suffix after NUL remains owned; cleanup after parse/event/output abort is safe. Serial equality alone is not the semantic oracle.

limitations: These limits reduce parse/expansion risk, not proof of C-library vulnerability freedom, strict time/memory ceilings, or responsive native layout of arbitrarily large literal fallback. No recipe is a pass until worker records actual selected nonzero test evidence.
